title: Winrate Tracker
description:
Winrate Tracker tracks your winrate over time!  Amazing!

Features include:
- Shows reports based on actual run history per-profile and per-ascension.
- Calculates total winrate and splits (per-month, per-patch, per-10 game samples, per-50 game samples).
- Per-character and time period filters.
- Per-card and per-relic winrates.
- Time of day splits (I'm better in the evening, which is odd!)
- Charts and graphs!  They're not that exciting, really, but they exist.
- Can optionally exclude floor 1 abandons.

Project source on Github here:  https://github.com/davekalina/spire2-winrate-tracker

Winrate Tracker works on both the main branch (version 0.111.1) and the beta branch (version 0.114.0).
changeNote:
v1.7.1

- Updated for Slay the Spire 2 version 0.114.0 on the beta branch, where Escape / B left the Win Rates screen with a popup or filter list still open, instead of closing it.
- Cards the game has renamed now count under their current name, such as Rapid Shot, which is Twin Shot from 0.114.0.
- Run tooltips mark Dread runs with the game's own Dread icon.
- The screen opens on the highest ascension that has runs under your filters, so co-op-only or rerolled Dread runs no longer open an empty Dread page.
